candidate_audit.interpretation: The operational candidate count is the current included set plus the persisted manual-audit overrides. These overrides are not scientific exclusion findings until adjudicated, and are not an extra PRISMA stage.

protocol.interpretation: These parameters describe the protocol contract for a fresh run. External API responses, cache state and metadata may change; they do not replace the current versioned snapshot exports.

deduplication_audit.interpretation: Exact normalized DOI/URL identity rows are removed deterministically from the PRISMA flow; normalized-title counts remain weaker candidates for semantic review because versioned records and unrelated works must remain distinct. The title metric includes identity-overlap rows; title_only is calculated after deterministic identity removal.

candidate_audit.interpretation: The 23-record candidate universe is preserved as historical context: 16 operationally retained records plus seven manual overrides. The current 18-record population is derived by the approved scope decisions and the 6918 year correction; it is not a new collection or an additional PRISMA stage.

manual_override_adjudication.interpretation: The ledger records evidence and proposed scope rationales for the persisted overrides; it does not replace supervisor adjudication.

manual_override_evidence_matrix.interpretation: The matrix records source-supported scope signals and required actions. It is evidence for adjudication, not a final inclusion or exclusion decision.

bibliography.separation_rule: The 18 included studies are derived from the review pipeline. Methodological, pedagogical, assessment and technical references are external to the pipeline study set and remain in the complete TCC bibliography.

blocking_reasons: Primary full text, criterion-level locators and adjudication are not complete.

methodological_appraisal.interpretation: The current MMAT ledger is a criterion-level preliminary record. Incomplete source retrieval or pending methodological adjudication blocks any final quality claim.
